# CodeHunter Lab

> AI consulting and automation agency based in Leiden, Netherlands.
> We design, build, and deploy AI agents, workflow automation, and custom integrations for businesses ready to move beyond pilots — production systems, not demos.

## About

CodeHunter Lab is an engineering-first AI consulting studio. We close the gap between AI proof of concept and production by building systems that integrate with your existing stack and run under real conditions.

Primary capabilities:
- AI consulting and strategy (discovery, scoping, roadmaps)
- AI agent development (WhatsApp bots, voice agents, sales and qualification agents)
- Workflow automation with n8n (migrating from Zapier/Make, custom pipelines)
- AI system integration (CRMs, ERPs, APIs, databases)
- Custom internal tools and admin dashboards
- LLM fine-tuning and private AI deployments

Supporting capabilities:
- Custom web application development (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- IT system integration (APIs, legacy modernization)
- System architecture design

Based in Leiden, Zuid-Holland. Serving clients across the Netherlands and internationally.

## Engagement Models

- **AI Strategy Sprint** (1–2 weeks): Workflow audit, automation opportunity map (prioritized by ROI), technical architecture proposal, budget and timeline estimate.
- **AI Implementation Project** (4–8 weeks): One live AI system deployed to your infrastructure. Full stack integration, documentation, and 30-day post-deployment support. Fixed scope, fixed price. You own the code.
- **Ongoing AI Partner** (monthly): Embedded AI engineering team. New automations, maintenance, and continuous scaling. Senior engineers, direct access.
